verdict.rationale: The SDK has strong first-party documentation for subagents (spawnable, isolated context, parallel, programmatic creation via `agents` param), agent teams (multiple Claude Code instances coordinated by a team lead), agent view for managing multiple background sessions, and session forking for branching workflows, directly supporting multi-agent orchestration within one workflow. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of multi-agent orchestration actually working in production, and more detail on cross-agent handoff mechanics beyond subagent spawning.
